description:
One row of a replay decision file.

Attributes:
    decision_date: The day the weight was decided, after its close; filled at the open of the
        next session.
    instrument_kind: The instrument's kind. A replay runs `equity` (bond ETFs included) and
        `fx`; the other kinds validate but are refused as not supported.
    instrument_id: A lake ticker, a futures root or an OSI symbol for an option.
    target_weight: Target weight, finite and within [-6, 6].
    status: `active`, `unavailable` or `error`; absent means `active`. A non-active row has
        weight 0.
    source: The name of the newest-dated input, listed in the submission's sources; empty
        together with `source_as_of`.
    source_as_of: When that input was published: a UTC timestamp (`2020-01-10T21:30:00Z`) or
        a date (`2020-01-10`); empty together with `source`.
    pod_id: The client's sub-book the row belongs to, if any. A `(decision_date,
        instrument_id)` pair may repeat when every row of it has a distinct, non-null
        `pod_id`; the replay trades the sum of the pair's `target_weight`, which must lie in
        [-6, 6].
    delta_equiv_weight: The delta-equivalent weight of an option row, if any; validated and
        unused.
title: DecisionFileRow
